title: Nvidia Shares Surge 30% as Board Reinstates CEO Jensen Huang Following High-Stakes Drama
snippet: Nvidia stock skyrocketed over 30% on Monday after the board reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO, ending a brief period of uncertainty for the AI chipmaking giant.
content:
Nvidia stock staged a massive rally on Monday, surging more than 30% after the company's board of directors announced the reinstatement of co-founder Jensen Huang as Chief Executive Officer. The dramatic turnaround follows high-level discussions regarding the leadership of the Silicon Valley giant, which sits at the epicenter of the global artificial intelligence boom.

A Swift Return to the Helm

In a formal announcement, Nvidia Board Chair Harvey Jones expressed full confidence in Huang's leadership following extensive dialogue between Huang and board members. The board noted it was fully satisfied with Huang's candor and vision moving forward.

"The board believes Jensen is the right person to lead Nvidia, and that his reinstatement is in the best interests of our stockholders, employees, partners, and customers," Jones stated. Jones also praised Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress for her steady leadership while pulling double duty as interim CEO during the transition period.

Huang greeted his return with optimism for the future of semiconductor technology and AI infrastructure. "I am honored to return to Nvidia and lead one of the most consequential technology companies in the world at the beginning of a new industrial revolution," Huang said in a statement.

Political Reactions and Market Impact

The reinstatement also drew attention from political figures, including Donald Trump, who commented on the move by emphasizing the nation's need to support top tech innovators. "We have to protect our geniuses," Trump remarked while addressing the board's decision to bring Huang back to the top post.

Wall Street responded with immediate enthusiasm. The 30% stock spike reflects renewed investor confidence in Nvidia's strategic direction as demand for its industry-leading AI chips continues to smash records globally.
